doc: SheetHeader offers sorting and filtering in the last frozen row of a Sheet.

1.doc: SortCol is the column, by which the application has sorted the rows, if SortDir is set.
1.name: SortCol

3.doc: Sort is a state, into which the client writes col,dir, when the user sorts by a column. It is zero, if sorting is not offered.
3.name: Sort

4.doc: SortableCols are the columns, which can be sorted. All columns, if empty.
4.name: SortableCols

5.doc: Filters are the filters, which the application has applied.
5.name: Filters

6.doc: Filter is a state, into which the client writes json {col,text}, when the user filters a column. An empty text removes the filter. It is zero, if filtering is not offered.
6.name: Filter

7.doc: FilterableCols are the columns, which can be filtered. All columns, if empty.
7.name: FilterableCols
